title: Build `fn()` and `spyOn()` by hand
acceptanceCriteria: A spy returns whatever its implementation returns
`.calls` holds every call's arguments, oldest first
`spyOn` still runs the original method, with the `this` it was called on — including a method spied on a class prototype
`restore()` puts the original method back on the object
Used as doubles for `checkout()`, a stub's answer reaches the code and the spy records the one receipt sent
